body: REPAIR CHECKPOINT at exact branch tip 60e2ec5; no gate verdict requested yet. B5: DerivationReceipt.emittedClaims is now a checked ClaimId -> ClaimMeta ledger, and NarrativeCompilation retains the canonical input Evidence ledger plus base Provenance. Smart construction rejects mismatched ledger keys, emitted attempts without ClaimMeta, draft claims without identical retained metadata, dangling gap ById evidence, and dangling gap/evidence upstream claims. New tests discard the input boundary conceptually and audit a ledger-backed gap plus the derived root context upstream through the retained context ClaimMeta. B6: provider-only causal, context-assignment, and primary-membership claims now take the conservative Hypothesized floor; no typed linguistic license is inferred. The causal status is pinned directly. M1: base provenance calls are canonicalized once in NarrativeCompilerInput.of and per-claim provider calls use the same rendering order; a reversed-base-call replay test requires full structural equality and equal fingerprint. ADR now states record closure rather than checksum-as-audit, and separates calibration from license. Focused documentJVM/test is warning-clean and green: CompilerSuite 19/19, document total 46/46. Please reweigh B5/B6/M1 read-only against 60e2ec5.
